_comment: Every key SBO's .aur parser reads (src/cl_dll/aurora/particlesys.cpp), with the defaults of ParticleType's constructor and the meaning from docs/AURORA.md. Shared by the web editor and a later in-game editor. kind: int | number | range (a number or min..max) | enum | type (a type name) | sprite | name. ui: a slider's span (the game has no bound unless 'limit' says so). tip: one short sentence (a tooltip). choiceLabels: each choice's plain name.

top.label: Particles
top.tip: How many particles the effect can show at once
top.help: Particles of this system at most, overlays included (1 to 2048, default 100). When they are all in use, a spray waits for a free one.

top.label: Main type
top.tip: The type that sits where the effect is and sprays the others
top.help: The type on the emitter: one particle that stays on the entity while the effect is on. Without it the system shows nothing.

top.label: Light model
top.tip: Whether the light in your map shades the particles

choiceLabels.2: Shaded by the map's light (same as 1)

top.help: XashXT key. 1: every particle is tinted by the world light where it is (sampled every 0.1 s of its age); 2 is the same in GoldSrc (no projected lights). The editor's Scene tab sets the light.

top.label: Kill condition
top.tip: When the effect stops for good
top.help: XashXT key, top level. The system stops for good once its emitter is in these contents (switching it on again does nothing); the particles alive finish. Only the emitter's point is tested. A Spawn Use copy ends there.

type.label: Name
type.tip: The name other types use to spray or draw this type
type.help: The type's name (29 characters at most; longer names are cut). spraytype, overlaytype and maintype refer to it.

type.label: Sprite
type.tip: The picture each particle shows
type.help: The sprite (sprites/x.spr). None, or not found: nothing drawn (the game prints a console line for a missing file).

type.label: Render mode
type.tip: How the picture blends with what is behind it
type.help: additive: glows, black is invisible (blend src-alpha, one). solid: alpha blended with the sprite's alpha, for sprites with a transparent background such as smoke. texture / color: alpha blended, but the engine's triangle API multiplies the color by alpha and draws it opaque (alpha fades to black); the depth buffer is written as the last mode left it.

type.label: Lifetime
type.tip: How many seconds each particle lives
type.help: Seconds the particle lives. A sprayed type needs it: 0 dies at once. For the main type: the length of a Spawn Use copy (5 s without it, 120 s at most).

type.label: Start size
type.tip: How big a particle is when it appears (its radius in units)
type.help: Half the width of the sprite square, in units (8 = 16 units wide). 0 or less is not drawn.

type.label: End size
type.tip: How big a particle is when it disappears (its radius in units)
type.help: The size at the end of its life (linear). When set, sizedelta is ignored.

type.label: Growth
type.tip: How much a particle grows each second, if End size is not set
type.help: Without endsize: units per second the size changes.

type.label: Start alpha
type.tip: How solid a particle is when it appears, from 0 to 1
type.help: Opacity 0 to 1 at the start of its life.

type.label: End alpha
type.tip: How solid a particle is when it disappears, from 0 to 1
type.help: Opacity 0 to 1 at the end of its life.

type.label: Start red
type.tip: How much red a particle has when it appears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The sprite's red at the start, 0 to 1 (not 0 to 255).

type.label: Start green
type.tip: How much green a particle has when it appears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The sprite's green at the start, 0 to 1.

type.label: Start blue
type.tip: How much blue a particle has when it appears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The sprite's blue at the start, 0 to 1.

type.label: End red
type.tip: How much red a particle has when it disappears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The red at the end of its life, 0 to 1.

type.label: End green
type.tip: How much green a particle has when it disappears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The green at the end of its life, 0 to 1.

type.label: End blue
type.tip: How much blue a particle has when it disappears, from 0 to 1
type.help: The blue at the end of its life, 0 to 1.

type.label: Start frame
type.tip: The frame of the picture a particle starts on
type.help: The sprite frame at the start (frames loop past the last one).

type.label: End frame
type.tip: The frame of the picture a particle ends on
type.help: The frame at the end of its life. When set, framerate is ignored.

type.label: Frame rate
type.tip: How many frames of the picture play each second, if End frame is not set
type.help: Without endframe: frames per second.

type.label: Start angle
type.tip: How far the picture is turned when a particle appears
type.help: The sprite's spin at the start, degrees (default 45).

type.label: Spin speed
type.tip: How fast the picture spins, in degrees each second
type.help: Spin, degrees per second.

type.label: Gravity
type.tip: Pulls particles up, or down if you use a negative number
type.help: Acceleration upward: positive rises (smoke 40), negative falls (sparks -300; the world's gravity is about -800).

type.label: Drag
type.tip: How quickly particles slow down to the speed of the wind
type.help: How fast the speed goes to the wind's (1 = about two thirds of the difference in a second; 0 = keeps its speed).

type.label: Wind yaw
type.tip: Which way the wind blows, where 0 is east and 90 is north
type.help: The wind's direction (0 = east, 90 = north) the particle drifts to with drag. A range gives each particle its own wind. The entity's angles do not turn it.

type.label: Wind strength
type.tip: How fast the wind blows
type.help: The wind's speed (with drag).

type.label: Spray type
type.tip: The type this particle sprays
type.help: The type this particle sprays.

type.label: Spray rate
type.tip: How many particles it sprays each second
type.help: Particles sprayed per second. Several a frame are sprayed when the rate is above the frame rate (at most 16 a frame).

type.label: Spray force
type.tip: How fast the sprayed particles fly off
type.help: The spray's speed, added to the parent's speed. 0: the child starts with the parent's speed only.

type.label: Spray pitch
type.tip: Sprays up or down, where -90 is straight up and 90 straight down
type.help: The spray's pitch: -90 up, 0 level, 90 down. The entity's pitch is added.

type.label: Spray yaw
type.tip: Which way it sprays, where 0 is east and 90 is north
type.help: The spray's yaw: 0 east, 90 north. The entity's yaw (or the followed entity's) is added.

type.label: Overlay type
type.tip: A second type drawn on top of this particle
type.help: A type drawn on this particle: same position, size and spin, its own sprite, colors, alpha and frame. It neither moves nor sprays and dies with the particle (4 layers deep at most).

type.label: Collision
type.tip: What a particle does when it hits a wall or the floor
type.help: none; die: the particle dies when it hits the world or a brush entity; bounce: it bounces off. Costs one trace per particle per frame.

type.label: Bounce
type.tip: How much speed a particle keeps when it bounces, from 0 to 1
type.help: With bounce: the share of the speed kept off the surface, 0 (stops against it, slides) to 1. A non-zero bounce alone also turns bouncing on (Spirit).

type.label: Bounce friction
type.tip: How much a bouncing particle slows down along the surface
type.help: With bounce: the share of the speed lost at each bounce (0 to 1).

type.label: Draw condition
type.tip: Shows particles only in the air, under water or inside walls
type.help: Draw only where the point is empty (air), water or solid. special, special1 to special3 are never true in GoldSrc (never drawn). One contents check per drawn particle.

type.label: Kill condition
type.tip: When the effect stops for good
type.help: Also read in a type block because XashXT's editor (pfxEd) saves it there: in any type it stops the whole system, the same as the top-level killcondition (not just this type). The last one read counts.

foreign.help: Not a script key in SBO (the game warns: unknown key). Set the attachment on the env_particle entity instead.
pfxEd's editor-only key; the game warns (unknown key) and ignores it.
pfxEd writes killcondition inside a type block; this build of the game does not read it there (unknown key). It belongs at the top level.
lightmodel is a top-level key; inside a type block the game warns (unknown key).
PrimeXT only; not read by SBO.
